item.title: Discovering the indieweb with calm tech
item.description:
They have become sirens that lure us into their ad-infested shores with their saccharine promise of dopamine. The user engages with StreetPass when they are ready, and on their own terms. Check out StreetPass and Blog Quest to discover a decentralized, independent Internet that puts you in control.
